summary: Every one of the n - 1 predecessor heights can independently change the required output, and the output itself can contain n - 1 indices, giving an Omega(n) lower bound matched by the scan.

optimality.argument: An unchecked predecessor can be changed from threshold to threshold + 1 and thereby change whether its successor must appear. Moreover, when all predecessors exceed threshold, writing the result requires n - 1 indices. The accepted implementation checks and potentially emits each successor once.

replacement_checks.evidence: All n - 1 predecessor cells are independently output-relevant, and the legal output size reaches n - 1.
The accepted implementation performs one strict comparison for every candidate successor and appends it at most once.
Regression exhausts all arrays over heights 1 through 3 for lengths 2 through 6 and thresholds 1 through 3, then checks empty, full, alternating, equality, and maximum-length output boundaries.
